title: Anti Spoofing Audio Watermarking
motto: Voice cloning shipped faster than defenses. 2026 production voice systems need two things: a detector (AASIST, RawNet2) that classifies real vs fake speech, and a watermark (AudioSeal) that survives compression and editing. Ship both or do not ship voice cloning.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Voice cloning shipped faster than defenses. 2026 production voice systems need two things: a detector (AASIST, RawNet2) that classifies real vs fake speech, and a watermark (AudioSeal) that survives compression and editing. Ship both or do not ship voice cloning.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards:
1. **Anti-spoofing / deepfake detection.** Given an audio clip, is it synthetic or real? ASVspoof benchmarks (ASVspoof 2019 → 2021 → 5) are the gold standard.
2. **Audio watermarking.** Embed an imperceptible signal in generated audio that a detector can extract later. AudioSeal (Meta) and WavMark are the open options.
3. **Authenticated provenance.** Cryptographic signing of audio files + metadata. C2PA / Content Authenticity Initiative.
